profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Pinterest

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and managed build and release workflows across a broad data center networking product portfolio.  
- Built and scaled an internal productivity platform used by 1,000+ engineers daily to support the commit lifecycle, including cloning, builds, testing, packaging, testbed reservation, static analysis, bug updates, and review workflows.  
- Designed and maintained nightly build and CI workflows for multiple product lines, improving consistency, reliability, and release readiness.  
- Modernized CI infrastructure by enabling on-demand build execution on Kubernetes, improving scalability, resilience, and overall resource efficiency through containerized builds.  
- Improved CI turnaround time by more than 70% through incremental build strategies, saving thousands of engineering hours.  
- Automated maintenance and patch release processes, reducing manual overhead and accelerating delivery to customers.  
- Developed the backend for a self-service build and release management portal, making build and release operations more accessible and efficient for engineering teams.  
- Drove build containerization efforts, supported microservices build infrastructure, simplified delivery workflows through pipeline-as-code, and contributed to migration toward modern source control practices.  
- Established unit and integration test infrastructure to support organizational code coverage and quality goals.  
- Designed REST APIs to enable cross-functional teams to consume critical build and release data.  
- Delivered build, sanity, and usage analytics that helped engineering leadership make more informed operational decisions.  

Tools & Technologies: Docker, Kubernetes, Python, Go, Jenkins, Airflow, Ansible, Bitbucket, SQL, MongoDB, Kafka, Grafana, Flask, Nginx

positions.title: Senior Software Test Automation Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on Google Assistant Readiness team, supporting certification for Google Assistant-enabled third-party devices.
- Designed and developed certification workflows and test infrastructure to evaluate speech and device performance.
- Built Python-based tools to validate smart devices before market release.
- Managed bi-weekly releases and enabled external partners to stay current with testing requirements.
- Created functional test plans for Google Assistant-enabled devices and supported audio validation through development of an acoustic isolation chamber.

positions.title: Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed and enhanced flight automation software for the Dragonfly drones project using Python and C++.  
- Automated and performed regression, sanity, and unit testing to validate drone functionality and reliability.  
- Executed and automated test workflows for the Linux Kernel Android Platform test team.  
- Worked across areas including automation, image processing, computer vision, visual inertial odometry, and obstacle avoidance.  

Tools & Technologies: Python, C++, Perl, Linux, Unit Testing, Regression Testing, Performance Testing, Automation, Image Processing, Computer Vision

positions.title: System Integration and Test Automation Engineer: Spring Intern
positions.description:
- Supported testing and automation efforts for LPWA network technology (RPMA).  
- Built a Python-based test automation framework and developed automated test scenarios from scratch in Linux (CentOS).  
- Performed regression and soak testing to improve product reliability and test coverage.  
- Troubleshot network issues across testbeds and helped identify and fix bugs in the software framework.  
- Created shell scripts and cron jobs to schedule regression runs and simplify test status reporting.  
- Worked with REST and AMQP services, including RabbitMQ and Qpid, to retrieve data over HTTP from Cassandra-backed systems.  

Tools & Technologies: Python, MySQL, Linux, REST, Selenium, SVN, Jenkins, TestLink

positions.title: System Integration and Test Automation Engineer: Summer Intern
positions.description:
- Tested an RPMA-based network built for machine-to-machine communication in IoT applications.  
- Developed key modules for a Python-based test automation framework.  
- Automated test scenarios in Python on Linux (CentOS) to improve test efficiency and coverage.  
- Identified critical bugs affecting communication reliability and partnered with the software team to investigate and resolve major issues.  
- Performed regression and soak testing across multiple testbeds.  
- Enhanced a Python web scraper by adding new features and improving functionality.  
- Troubleshot network issues and contributed to better understanding of end-to-end communication flows.  
- Maintained test documentation and automation status in TestLink, including clear steps for execution and network setup.  
- Worked extensively in a Linux environment and used SVN for version control.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Conducted research on the use of FM white space for Home Area Networks.  
- Developed a MAC-layer scheme to support low-power operation and prioritized channel access for IoT use cases.  
- Worked across research areas including RFID, 6LoWPAN, IEEE 802.15.4, NB-IoT, M2M communication, sensing, and actuation.

volunteerExperiences.description: Co-ordinated in an Arduino based Hackathon organized by IEEE Ahmedabad. Conceptualized technical layout and maintained logistics.
Rendered services as a writer for Board examination of Blind people.

projects.title: Machine to Machine Communication Network Design for Wireless Sensor Networks
projects.description:
● Outlined Node and Network Architecture for a Vehicular Wireless Network.
● Developed Address Allocation and Routing Protocols. 
● Designed Power Efficient Sleeping Schedules for Nodes.
● Discussed issues addressed in a System with 2 Gateways and effects of Network Overlap.

projects.title: Video Codec Design
projects.description:
● Developed MPEG based Video Encoder and Decoder to understand working principles of Video Coding.
● Performed Motion Estimation and explored concepts of Motion Vectors, DCT, Quantization, Search Windows and MUX to achieve efficient Video Compression.
● Codec met PSNR and MSE requirements.
